dispatchers.name: tmux_target:run/3
dispatchers.why: Validates and executes a named tmux command through the endpoint operation owner.

reaches.why: Admission delivers the packed command to the endpoint owner. Its scheduler validates the lease and identity preflight, then starts the command stage with the stored argv; this process-message boundary is not a direct call edge.
The OTP child spec starts the transport owner; init schedules its launch continuation, whose handle_continue calls launch/2 with the validated executable and argv.
